body: ## Export summary card The weekly export summary becomes a card. Screenshots from the issue it fixes: ![The summary before the change](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5b1d1c1e-0f2a-4c3b-9d4e-000000000001) | Before | After | |---|---| | | | - A transparent PNG through GitHub's image proxy: ![Dice with transparency](https://images.example.invalid/dice.png) - A linked photograph: [![A flower](https://images.example.invalid/flower.png)](https://images.example.invalid/flower) - An animated GIF at a set height: Build status: ![build](https://images.example.invalid/badge.svg) `` stays code.
title: Show the weekly export summary as a card
